title: The 5M: BOS #2
hook: Correction #1 is over when the 5M breaks again. That break is BOS #2, and it still isn’t your entry.

launchpad.outcome: Identify BOS #2 on the 5M: the first candle close through the high (bullish) or low (bearish) that Correction #1 pulled back from.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Why is BOS #2 a step in the sequence, not a signal to trade?

takeaways: BOS #2 is a 5M continuation break in the intended direction.
Bullish: a 5M candle closes above the high Correction #1 pulled back from. Bearish: a 5M candle closes below the low Correction #1 pulled back from.
Wicks don’t count. BOS #2 needs a 5M candle close.
You still don’t enter on BOS #2. Correction #2, BOS #3 and the retest come next.
remember: BOS #2 CONTINUES THE STORY. IT DOESN’T START THE TRADE.

slides.headline: Correction #1 is done. Now the 5M breaks again.
slides.line: That second break is BOS #2 (the second break of structure). It confirms the move is continuing, and it still isn’t your entry.

slides.headline: BOS #2 is a 5M continuation close.
slides.line: Tap each card. Three things make a BOS #2.

cards.label: On the 5M
cards.sub: BOS #1 happens on the 15M. BOS #2 happens on the 5M, after Correction #1.

cards.label: Through the Correction #1 swing
cards.sub: Bullish: a close above the high Correction #1 pulled back from. Bearish: a close below the low it pulled back from.

cards.label: A candle close
cards.sub: Wicks don’t count. A 5M candle has to close through the level.

slides.headline: Watch Correction #1 end and BOS #2 print.
slides.line: Bullish example. Press the button to print each part.

steps.caption: Correction #1. After BOS #1, the 5M pulls back from a high. Mark that high: it’s the level BOS #2 has to close through.
BOS #2. The first 5M candle to close above the high Correction #1 pulled back from. The move is continuing.
Still no entry. There’s no zone yet. Correction #2 hasn’t formed, and BOS #3 hasn’t happened.

slides.headline: Bearish this time. Find BOS #2.
slides.line: Correction #1 is marked. In a bearish model it bounces up from a low.
slides.ask: Tap the first 5M candle that closes below the low Correction #1 pulled back from.
slides.why: That’s the first 5M candle close below the low Correction #1 pulled back from. That’s BOS #2.

after.caption: BOS #2 is in. You still don’t enter. Next you wait for Correction #2.

slides.headline: A wick pokes through. Is that BOS #2?
slides.line: Bullish model. A 5M candle trades above the Correction #1 high, then closes back below it.

options.label: Yes, price traded above the high
options.feedback: Trading through isn’t enough. BOS #2 needs a 5M candle to close above the high Correction #1 pulled back from.

options.label: No, BOS #2 needs a 5M candle close above the high
options.why: Right. Wicks don’t count. Wait for a 5M candle that closes through the level.

slides.headline: No BOS #2. No sequence.
slides.line: Bearish example. Watch what happens after Correction #1.

steps.caption: BOS #1. A 15M candle closes below the 15M level, in the direction of the higher-timeframe story.
Correction #1. The 5M bounces up from a low. BOS #2 would be a 5M close below that low.
No 5M candle closes below that low. BOS #2 never happens, so the sequence is incomplete.

check.prompt: BOS #1 and Correction #1 are done, but BOS #2 never came. What do you do?

options.label: Enter short, BOS #1 already confirmed the direction
options.feedback: Don’t enter simply because BOS #1 occurred. Without BOS #2 there’s no Correction #2, no zone and no BOS #3.

options.label: No trade, the sequence is incomplete
options.why: Right. The sequence needs all of its parts. With no BOS #2, there’s nothing to trade.

slides.quote: BOS #2 tells you the story is still going. It doesn’t tell you to trade.

slides.prompt: In your own words, what is BOS #2, and why don’t you enter on it?
slides.modelAnswer: BOS #2 is the first 5M candle that closes through the high (bullish) or the low (bearish) that Correction #1 pulled back from. A wick through the level doesn’t count. I don’t enter on BOS #2 because the zone doesn’t exist yet: Correction #2 has to create it, BOS #3 has to activate it, and then I wait for price to return to it.
